project: hBN coating on VGCF (Li-metal anode host)
method: QE 7.4.1-GPU (kgy), PBE-D3BJ, PAW kjpaw 60/480 Ry, 4x4 supercell (Li-Li 9.84 A), k 3x3x1, mv 0.01, relax 1e-3 Ry/Bohr. E_bind = E(host+Li) - E(host) - E(Li_atom). Shi2017-matched.

layer_convergence.note: gallery 4칸 스프레드 52 meV (-1.574~-1.626): 단조 심화, 협동항 ~28 meV. 표면 VGCF만 층수 민감(-151 meV).

shi_eq5: gallery < min(VGCF, hBN) all combos — sandwich strongest, VGCF plays the Cu role
headline: gallery = 최안정이면서 전부 lithiophobic(+0.10~+0.15 eV): VGCF는 Cu의 구조 역할(샌드위치 안정화)을 과도한 lithiophilic 앵커링 없이 수행. 층수 수렴 입증(gallery<=52 meV) — 1L 모델로 NEB 정당.

representative_for_paper.rationale: h-BN 2L matches Liu2022(AMI 9,2200011) reference (h-BN|Li|Cu 2-layer h-BN); VGCF 2L matches real multilayer graphite fiber (and bulk Cu in ref). 1L1L(-1.574) cited as layer-convergence evidence (spread 52 meV).

reference_comparison_Liu2022.citation: Liu et al., Adv. Mater. Interfaces 2022, 9, 2200011
reference_comparison_Liu2022.note: both vs isolated Li atom, so directly comparable; bottom = Cu (Liu) vs VGCF (ours)

sandwich_gallery.verdict: 약함 = 바닥 Cu→VGCF; 차별점: VGCF가 Cu 구조역할하되 과잉 lithiophilic 앵커 없이

cdd_planned: graphene / hbn / gallery_2L2L 3종 CDD (ρ_complex − ρ_host − ρ_Li) — Liu (f)(g) 대응 비교그림. VGCF가 전자받개(Cu역할), h-BN 수동캡 시각화.
